title: AutoTailor: Automatic, User-Aligned Capability Selection and Adaptation for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents can utilize reusable tools to reduce the cost and latency of low-level browser interaction, but automatically discovered tool collections can be large, redundant, and poorly aligned with user demand. We present AutoTailor, a meta-agentic framework for constructing and maintaining a compact set of trajectory-derived Model Context Protocol (MCP) APIs. Offline, AutoTailor converts web trajectories into parameterized browser-automation programs, applies a Quality Filter to remove APIs with unsuitable granularity and redundant functionality, and applies a Usage Likelihood Filter to prioritize broadly useful capabilities while preserving semantic coverage. Online, Dynamic Reselection monitors task outcomes and API usage, identifies recurring coverage gaps, adds relevant candidates, and prunes persistently unused capabilities. We evaluate AutoTailor on 106 WebArena Postmill tasks. Offline filtering reduces the initial 1,283 unrefined

translated_title: AutoTailor：面向网络代理的自动、用户对齐的能力选择与自适应
translated_abstract: 网络代理可以利用可复用的工具来降低底层浏览器交互的成本和延迟，但自动发现的工具集合可能庞大、冗余，且与用户需求匹配度差。我们提出了AutoTailor，这是一个元智能体框架，用于构建和维护由轨迹导出的紧凑的模型上下文协议（MCP）API集合。在离线阶段，AutoTailor将网络轨迹转换为参数化的浏览器自动化程序，应用质量过滤器去除粒度不合适和功能冗余的API，并应用使用可能性过滤器在保持语义覆盖的同时优先保留广泛有用的能力。在在线阶段，动态重选机制监控任务结果和API使用情况，识别反复出现的覆盖缺口，添加相关候选API，并修剪持续未使用的能力。我们在106个WebArena Postmill任务上评估了AutoTailor。离线过滤将最初的1,283个未精炼的（摘要在此截断）
tldr: AutoTailor提出了一种元智能体框架，通过离线的质量过滤与使用可能性过滤，以及在线的动态重选机制，自动构建和维护紧凑且与用户需求对齐的网络代理MCP工具集，有效去除冗余API并填补能力覆盖缺口。
en_tdlr: AutoTailor is a meta-agentic framework that automatically constructs and maintains a compact, user-aligned set of trajectory-derived MCP APIs for web agents via offline quality and usage-likelihood filtering combined with online dynamic reselection.
